import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'

import { ThemeProvider } from 'styled-components'

import { Footer } from '../workspace/src/components/Footer/Footer'
import { lightTheme } from '../workspace/src/styles/theme'

      <MemoryRouter>

  )

})
EOF

cat > /workspace/src/components/Footer/__tmp_footer.test.ts <<'EOF'
import { createElement as h } from 'react'
import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import { MemoryRouter } from 'react-router-dom'
import { ThemeProvider } from 'styled-components'
import { expect, test } from 'vitest'

import { Footer } from './Footer'
import { lightTheme } from '../../styles/theme'

test('footer renders a small Order help button', () => {
  render(h(ThemeProvider, { theme: lightTheme }, h(MemoryRouter, null, h(Footer))))
  const button = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Order help' })
  expect(button).toBeTruthy()
  expect(button.tagName).toBe('BUTTON')
  // small = default size: the large variant's padding must not be applied
  expect(getComputedStyle(button).padding).not.toContain('1.125rem')
})
EOF
npx vitest run --config vitest.config.app.ts --project node src/components/Footer/__tmp_footer.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -25
rm -f /workspace/src/components/Footer/__tmp_footer.test.ts && git -C /workspace status --short src/components/Footer && git -C /workspace diff -- src/components/Footer/Footer.tsx
